explained.summary: Keep the whole picture in view: all of time and all of matter. Against that, any single thing is as small as a fig seed in size and as brief as one turn of a gimlet, a little hand drill, in time. The exercise is about perspective. Whatever looms large today shrinks once you see where it sits.
